rule: Count every source Sense–Scene association as one record; same Global Sense in multiple scenes counts once PER association toward the 3000-row batch, even when it shares one Global Sense identity.
sense_identity: Global Sense deduplication remains an independent semantic workflow, never a filter or batch gate.
candidate_policy: HOLD candidates remain in original source order and count as source association records; annotate HOLD without excluding from batch.
data_immutability: Keep V108, Reviewed V13, V179–V185, original Master and SRS untouched; new versions are additive.
example_policy: 1–3 bilingual example pairs per Sense–Scene association; synonyms, antonyms and sense disambiguation are fields requiring evidence.
release: staging until independent QA, no fabricated identity IDs, no formal Ready
